messages:
Maria L: Heads up — after the auth-proxy cutover at 08:12 UTC a subset of users report 403 during SSO and some service accounts were deprovisioned then reprovisioned repeatedly.
Ben T: seeing same. Provisioner logs show SCIM 409 Conflict + KMS decrypt errors. grabbing snippets...
Ben T:
```
provisioner-0 | 2026-03-22T08:14:01Z ERROR scim: PATCH /Users/abc123 409 Conflict: externalId collision
provisioner-0 | 2026-03-22T08:14:02Z ERROR kms: decrypt failed alias/ri-prod-kms: InvalidCiphertextException
```
Samir K: Could be cookie state mismatch between old and new proxy (SameSite / Path) — idp might be sending a lingering session cookie that the new proxy interprets as a deprovision trigger.
Alice P: Also check whether we rotated KMS alias last night. If the envelope key changed but old tokens still in flight, decrypts will fail.
Maria L: @deploy-bot can you post the deploy timeline for the cutover? We need to correlate.
deploy-bot: cutover-window: 2026-03-22T08:10:00Z -> 2026-03-22T08:20:00Z. rollouts: auth-proxy v2 -> 3/4 nodes, provisioner unchanged.
idp-monitor: alert: idp-heartbeat returned 503 for 08:11:58-08:12:05 UTC, recovered at 08:12:12 UTC
Samir K: repro steps I'm running:
1) create temp user with extid tmp-xyz
2) auth via idp/postassert
3) observe provisioner PATCH
`curl -v -H "Cookie: sid=<old-encoded-session>" https://app.redwood.example/login`
Ben T: can someone dump the SCIM request payload for affected user? need to see externalId vs idp assertion mapping.
Alice P: quick KMS query: `gcloud logging read "resource.type=kms_crypto_key AND protoPayload.methodName:Decrypt"` — look for InvalidCiphertextException around 08:14.
Maria L: OK action items:
- Maria L: collect 10 sample affected user IDs + SCIM payloads
- Ben T: capture provisioner logs and open INC-2026
- Samir K: reproduce cookie-state repro and test clearing SameSite=Strict
- Alice P: check KMS alias rotation history & key policy
We'll sync in 30m in #inc-2026. :thumbsup:
